title: I made an incremental clicker about defending a flock of rubber ducks from waves of demons with no game dev experience.
author: BadDuckGames
selftext:
The game is called "Ducks VS Demons" and the demo will be featured in the October Steam NextFest. It's an incremental clicker/idler heavily inspired by PopCap's "Insaniquarium," which I loved as a kid. This is my first attempt at making a game, and I have ZERO experience writing code.

The code was generated by Google Gemini 3.1 Pro. The visuals, music, and sound effects are either purchased assets or ones I created myself. While I can't write code, I didn't want the game to feature any AI-generated audio or visuals, so I prompted for the ability to load these assets from specified folders based on their file names.

I spent dozens of hours iterating on the generated code, playtesting, and selecting assets until I had a fun and functional web game. I knew I wanted to release the game on Steam instead of simply hosting it on my website, so I packaged the game using Electron.

The game loop revolves around feeding your rubber ducks and collecting the loot they drop. Eventually, they will level up, drop more valuable loot, and even evolve! Evolved ducks have special abilities like dropping food or attacking demons, which spawn every few minutes. There's a short, linear Adventure Mode, as well as an endurance-based Survival Mode.

This was a super fun and rewarding project, and I have a few other games in progress now. I hope the game sells well enough that I can break even, and I'm excited to release more games in 2027 and beyond!
